summary: GoPro, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 1, 2026, announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Action Acquisitions LLC (Parent) and its wholly owned subsidiary Starman Optical, Inc. (Merger Sub). Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into GoPro, with GoPro surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. The filing does not disclose deal terms such as price per share or premium. GoPro intends to file a proxy statement and solicits stockholder approval. No board recommendation or advisors are named. What to watch: proxy statement details, regulatory approvals, and any competing bids or shareholder opposition.
